pipedrive.description: Pipedrive CRM integration — deals, contacts, activities, pipeline stages. Set PIPEDRIVE_API_TOKEN env var before use.

zapier.description: Zapier webhook integration — trigger zaps, send payloads. Set ZAPIER_WEBHOOK_BASE env var before use.

jotform.description: Jotform integration — intake forms, feedback forms, submissions. Set JOTFORM_API_KEY env var before use.

setup_instructions:
To enable live integrations, set these environment variables:
  export PIPEDRIVE_API_TOKEN='your-pipedrive-api-token'
  export PIPEDRIVE_DOMAIN='yourcompany.pipedrive.com'
  export ZAPIER_WEBHOOK_BASE='https://hooks.zapier.com/hooks/catch/YOUR_ID'
  export JOTFORM_API_KEY='your-jotform-api-key'

Without these, commands will operate in template mode (manual data input).
